quest.title: Farewell, Final Saurus Cracker
quest.description: Looks like it'll take more effort to get everything cleared up...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Indwell an Iktomisaurus and track the strange scent
Get to an elevated vantage point to get a better view of the situation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are there Saurus Crackers here? This letter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Quilla was the mastermind, just like Paimon thought! Even if it was for an unexpected reason... Ugh, Paran's got rotten luck for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just thinking about how Taruka and Oberon might be imprisoned in the camp in front of us makes Paimon feel bad about doing nothing... They didn't do anything wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME}, let's think of a way to save them, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we can <color=#00E1FFFF>hide amidst the Iktomisaurus patrol squad</color>, maybe we'll have an easier time getting in!

talks.objective: Disguise yourself and follow the Iktomisaurus patrol to infiltrate the camp

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Cooo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Is that you, Oberon?

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Croooo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You've, ah, grown a lot since we last met...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess Taruka was right about you gaining weight easily. Oh right, where is he? Why isn't he with you?

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Cooo... Crrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, at any rate, we should probably get out of here first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that we've found Oberon, we don't have to hide anymore, right? Paimon's still worried, though, we don't know where Taruka is... We gotta hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Since you've managed to find your way here, I suppose I can finally drop the "good merchant" act. I need a breather from dealing with all the idiots.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You meanie! How can you pin the blame for your crimes on other people? Everyone got the wrong idea about us thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: I'm a villain. Is it not natural for a villain to do bad things? Besides, doesn't the fact that those three idiots misunderstood prove that I'm good at what I do?

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Haha, and now I'm going to do something more wicked still! This time, you're not going to get away.

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Go get them, Furball!

dialogues.speaker: Furball
dialogues.text: Gwoooo!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Let's go, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Are you really gonna take on someone that much bigger than you?

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crrooo...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oberon looks kinda out of it. Is he just worried about Taruka, or has he eaten too many Saurus Crackers...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Maybe {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} really wants to cheer him up, so he bravely stepped out to protect us?

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: The things in this world that courage alone cannot change outnumber the sand grains of Sumeru. Compared to something illusory like that, absolute control is more reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Attack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Amazing! {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} dodged the attack! That's just what Tepetlisaurs are good at, not even the sovereign of the skies can touch 'em!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is ready to attack!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The attack hit! It dealt... almost no damage!?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, getting a hit in is already pretty impressive! Phew— Paimon's kinda feeling tired already. Have we really only gone one round? What's going on...

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: It's my turn now, right? Attack!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} quickly assumes a defensive stance to weather the opponent's fierce assault! He successfully blocks it!

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Wait, your Saurian defended on his own right after attacking! Tch, despicable rule breaker...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The best way to win a turn-based game is not to take turns!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What should we do next?

response.speaker: Oberon
response.text: ...Krraaaaa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Oberon seems to be pulling himself together!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't understand what they're saying, but it looks like they've reached some kind of... mutual understanding...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Here we go! Show us what the flight school's future star is capable of!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oberon has blocked the opponent's aerial escape route, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is launching an attack! A brilliant coordinated strike!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a lot of damage Furball's taking! Did it eat a bad hit to the foot? Like, "stubbing your toe against the corner of a table," bad? Either way, the opponent seems shaken up and unable to move!

choices.text: Attack, but I'm the one attacking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You could do that... but c'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} doesn't get lots of chances to show his stuff as-is, so stop being so childish!

response.speaker: Oberon
response.text: Kraaaa!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh? It looks like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and Oberon have a plan...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Saurus Crackers? Where did these Saurus Crackers come from?

response.speaker: Oberon
response.text: Coo! Krraaa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, were you hiding them under your wings? What a cunning little Saurian... Taruka must have such a hard time dealing with you.

response.speaker: Oberon
response.text: Crrooo...

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Now's not the time! Hey! Stop!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Furball ignored her command and ran towards the Saurus Crackers! The chance to recover 5 HP is just too tempting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Little does it know that it's the Saurian being served on that plate!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #In summary, the battle continued on in this way, each party trading hits.\n{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} acted courageously, of course, like he was trying to prove himself. Though he would not ever be considered an outstanding student at the flight school, he could still use his other abilities to help his companions.\nSurprisingly, even Oberon's unexpected weight gain helped. Now granted a larger physique than the average Qucusaurus, he closed off the aerial battlefield and dealt Furball a heavy blow...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Quilla herself proved useless in a fight, and thus fled after Furball lost the will to fight.\n"You damned rule breaker! You... You won't win that easily next time! Just you wait and see!"\nAfter reciting the trite lines that petty villains such as herself are wont to say, she ran away with the injured Furball.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Paimon forgot to ask her where Taruka is...

response.speaker: Oberon
response.text: Crooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, cheer up for now. Taruka's a smart kid. He'll be fine!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yes, that's what you think too, right, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? C'mon, Oberon, let's get you back to the flight school first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If words could solve problems, why would there be so many conflicts in the world?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem... Paimon's just saying that it isn't likely to work.

choices.text: Capture it with a magical item.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wooo... Rrroo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #C'mon! You're even getting {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} down now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, we're two against one here. Our opponent probably can't attack both targets at once, so isn't this a waste of a turn?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eat Saurus Crackers to recover 5 HP!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Not that that's necessary!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, things are going well. Why are you still thinking about running away!?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rooo... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} seems to feel like defending too conservatively will lead to wasted opportunity. He's getting ready to attack!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's nothing we can use right now! Also, don't you think it's a bit too late to set Beast Trap now?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rooo... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh! {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is ready to attack!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This isn't the time to run away!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrrooo... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Even {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} gets it! Look, he's ready to attack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Taruka! You're back already!

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! I'm so glad you're okay... I've told my sister and everyone about what happened. Lamizana's just as big of an idiot as I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crooo...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Yes, even dumber than you, birdbrain!

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, okay, guess he's really upset after being separated from you for so long. Also, he worked super well with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} just now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's still room for more improvement.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we're still talking about a little Saurian, here! As long as you treat him right, Taruka, Paimon's sure he'll grow into an outstanding Qucusaurus!

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Kraaaa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, how did you get back here? Did someone find you and save you?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I escaped by myself. I wanted to bring Oberon with me, but he was busy eating Saurus Crackers and wouldn't move no matter what I did. I got angry, so I left by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It was that easy?

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: After figuring out the movement patterns of the Saurian guards, I realized there was an opening I could use to escape. Got out of there smoothly afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, you might just be the most reliable one here...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: What took you so long? I was just about to settle matters with that liar... a—and officially apologize to you guys, of course... I was way too arbitrary, and almost framed innocent people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! You only appeared after everything ended. If that isn't trying to steal credit, then what is?

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: I haven't any leg to stand on, so I'll pay you the agreed compensation or whatever you want from me. I won't be stingy about it. You can even punch me if it'll make you feel better!

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: I'm a real man, so I won't try to weasel out of my responsibilities.

choices.text: #We'll get {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to give you a punch.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: Ouch! Ow! I haven't been hit, but it already hurts! Please stay your merciful hands... and feet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't you just say you're a real man who won't try to weasel out? How pathetic.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Forget it, we're not that petty. Don't you agree, {NICKNAME}, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Lamizana
response.text: Thanks for forgiving me. The flight school... well, it has no doors, but its figurative doors will always be open to you.

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: #Since you and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} are so close, I wanted to ask you for the secret to getting along well with little Saurians!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, no problem. We'll be back later if we get the chance!

choices.text: #I'll have {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} kick you in the toes.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: I request monetary compensation! And my participation prize.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you haven't forgotten about the participation prize...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You return to your previous location before you can be discovered. Try to be a bit more careful next time...

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: We still have a few more flying challenges. Details are written on the board. Give 'em a try if you're keen... Of course, there are prizes to be won.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Honestly, I have no clue why it's called that. But speaking of Pakpaka... Have you ever heard the story of Kuntur and the evil sorcerer Rumi?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: The warriors of the tribe were defeated by that wicked mage, and he turned them into Pakpaka... which doesn't sound all that good. Maybe Pakpakas fly very quickly, or something — I don't know.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Haha... He's a good fighter, but not necessarily a good teacher. And as an opponent in flying competitions... I guess he's passable?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: But I mean, why would you come here if you didn't have issues with flying? So, if I were to be too strict... *sigh* Well, it's not like things like this have never happened in the past.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: That's why I focus on encouraging people nowadays. I'm sure that approach will get results just fine too.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: See you. You're welcome back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Cisik
dialogues.text: Welcome to Pakpaka Flying School!

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: We give all cadets the necessary guidance and help they need. Things have changed a lot, you know. Back in the day, students couldn't expect that kind of tender loving care.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: But then there was this one time when the coach was a little... strict with their words, and the student in question just happened to have quite a temper... *sigh* Yeah, that's not a fun one to talk about.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Anyway, our teaching policy's been shaken up since then. And I mean, nobody slaps a smiling face, and nobody hates compliments, am I right?

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Here's to a pleasant day!
